reported_issue: Sometimes the ShopCoach line builder needs to be run multiple times before it works. It stops loading and gives no results; clicking Build Lines again restarts it and it loads the second time. Issue is intermittent and not reproduced every time.
expected_after_fix: ShopCoach line builder should reliably return results on the first run.
steps_i_followed: Opened multiple estimate work orders' Lines tab (S12-24939, S12-24579, S12-23512, S12-23300).
For each, typed a prompt into the ShopCoach 'Dot Inspection...' field and clicked Build Lines.
Watched the POST /api/shopcoach/run-assistant response and the resulting UI for each run.
Ran the builder 4 times total across different WOs; on a repeated same-WO attempt, re-triggered to check the 'run again' path.
actual_now: Every ShopCoach build attempt returned HTTP 200 with valid line suggestions and rendered the 'SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER' preview panel (e.g. 'Replace air filter' 0.3h + Engine Air Filter part, 'Check tire pressure' 0.2h) with an 'Add (N Lines)' button. No run stalled or returned empty results. The builder produced results on the first run in 4/4 attempts. (Note: line count doesn't auto-increment until the user clicks 'Add (N Lines)', which is the expected review flow, not a failure.)
notes: Bug is intermittent by nature; could not reproduce any stall/no-results across 4 runs — builder worked reliably each time. Confidence medium because an intermittent failure cannot be fully ruled out from a limited sample.
